usageNotes: Permanently deletes an SDN prefix list from the cluster configuration; requires the SDN.Allocate privilege on the specific prefix list path. Before deleting, ensure the prefix list is not referenced by any SDN zone, VNet, or firewall policy — removing a referenced list will leave dangling references that block SDN apply operations. After deletion, run the SDN apply operation (POST /cluster/sdn) to push the change to all nodes.

examples.summary: Delete an unused BGP prefix list named 'allowed-prefixes'

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named prefix list and all its configured prefix entries from the cluster SDN configuration with no undo path.
tips: Use get_cluster_sdn_prefix_lists_id first to confirm the target prefix list exists and note any references before deleting.
The optional 'lock-token' parameter is required only if the SDN configuration is currently locked by another operation — obtain it via the SDN lock endpoint.
Deletion only updates the pending SDN config; run POST /cluster/sdn to apply and propagate the change to all cluster nodes.
